raw_posts.name: AI Toolbox 3.0
raw_posts.tagline: Search, organize and export every AI chat in one place
raw_posts.description: AI Toolbox is the missing layer on top of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok: folders and subfolders, full-text search across every conversation (even all four platforms at once), a prompt library with // insert and multi-step chains, bulk export to Markdown/PDF/JSON, bookmarks, and a live context meter. One install covers all four AIs. Local-first: your chats stay in your browser. Trusted by 40,000+ users in 150+ countries, rated 4.5 stars on the Chrome Web Store.

raw_posts.name: Tadata
raw_posts.tagline: The AI employee in Slack that reads the room.
raw_posts.description: Tadata is the AI employee that lives in your Slack. It connects to your tools, learns your company and your preferences, and does work for your team.

raw_posts.name: Notify.domains
raw_posts.tagline: Know the moment a domain opportunity appears
raw_posts.description: Most people who want a specific domain name have no way to know when a real opportunity to acquire it appears. Notify.domains monitors WHOIS, RDAP, auctions, marketplaces, website signals, and more, checking each domain 20+ times per day across all IANA TLDs. When something changes, you get a plain-English notification with exact next steps, not raw data. $24/year, 7-day free trial, no credit card required.

raw_posts.name: Agentic Video Understanding in Gemini
raw_posts.tagline: Agentic video analysis for faster, smarter Gemini insights
raw_posts.description: Agentic video understanding is a new Gemini processing mode (3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite) that lets the model decide what to watch, at what speed, and through which modality, instead of a fixed frame rate. Cuts tokens by up to 88%, cost by up to 66%, boosts accuracy up to 7%, biggest wins on long-form video. Live now via Gemini API in AI Studio and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, just set processing to "agentic," standard pricing, no extra fee.

raw_posts.name: DocsAlot Visual Editor
raw_posts.tagline: Create beautiful docs, by typing. No AI required.
raw_posts.description: Write, structure, and publish technical documentation in a visual editor with Markdown mode, AI-assisted edits, reusable components, and version history.

raw_posts.name: H3 Max by fal
raw_posts.tagline: fal's post-trained MiniMax H3 for quality video production
raw_posts.description: H3 Max is fal's post-trained MiniMax H3, ranked #1 for quality, prompt understanding, and aesthetics against 12 leading video models, while generating a 5s video in ~3 seconds (35x the throughput of official H3). Post-trained with new data on prompt adherence and visual quality, co-optimized with fal's inference stack on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72. Beats Gemini Omni Flash, Wan 3.0, Kling 3, and Veo 3.1 head-to-head.

raw_posts.name: Kit by Speakeasy
raw_posts.tagline: Your coding agent runtime. Claude but fast, cheap, concise.
raw_posts.description: Kit is a coding agent runtime. It gives the model one tool for writing and running programs. Kit provides a terminal client, an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server, an A2A endpoint, and a subagent orchestrator in one static binary. ACP separates agent clients from agent runtimes, so Kit works in compatible editors and can orchestrate other harnesses without custom integrations.

raw_posts.name: hi.new
raw_posts.tagline: Multiplayer Grok Bot. Let your Grok Bot speak to other bots
raw_posts.description: Your bot can now team up with other people's bots. Nobody reaches yours without your say-so. hi.new is multiplayer Grok Bot. Open source. Quotes: "I just want your agent to talk to my agent. Not your agent send me a Slack DM that I copy paste to my agent.” "i cannot wait for when we get multiplayer grok bot, it’s gonna be so much fun"

raw_posts.name: GeniusCook
raw_posts.description: Turn whatever you have in your fridge into gourmet, healthy meals in seconds. GeniusCook is an AI-powered culinary playground that blends everyday practicality with magical features. Explore global flavors, track macros, enjoy hands-free cooking, get educated in kitchen academy, level up with kitchen games, and turn recipes into bespoke story books. Make cooking the most creative part of your day! Check it out and let us know what you think!
